name: Zedekiah
bio: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was among the four hundred prophets Ahab assembled to ask whether to attack Ramoth Gilead. He made himself horns of iron and declared, "Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them," joining the rest in promising Ahab victory (1 Kings 22:6, 11-12). When Micaiah alone prophesied disaster, revealing that the LORD had put a lying spirit in the mouths of Ahab's prophets, Zedekiah struck him on the cheek and demanded to know by what path the Spirit of the LORD had left him to speak to Micaiah instead. Micaiah answered that Zedekiah would see for himself on the day he went to hide in an inner chamber (1 Kings 22:24-25).
